<style>
/* Hide TT4 theme chrome */
.wp-site-blocks > header,
.wp-site-blocks > footer,
header.wp-block-template-part,
footer.wp-block-template-part,
.wp-block-template-part:first-child { display: none !important; }
.wp-block-post-title, .wp-block-spacer { display: none !important; }

html, body, .wp-site-blocks {
  background: #F5F4EF !important;
  background-color: #F5F4EF !important;
}

#pacerai-blog {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 100vw;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

.wp-site-blocks,
.wp-site-blocks > main,
.wp-site-blocks > main > .wp-block-group,
.wp-site-blocks .is-layout-constrained,
.wp-site-blocks .is-layout-constrained > :where(:not(.alignleft):not(.alignright):not(.alignfull)),
.has-global-padding,
.entry-content {
  max-width: none !important;
  padding-left: 0 !important;
  padding-right: 0 !important;
  margin-left: 0 !important;
  margin-right: 0 !important;
  padding-top: 0 !important;
}

  :root {
    /* v3 Claude-bone: token NAMES kept, VALUES flipped to the bone palette. */
    --navy: #F5F4EF;        /* page ground (bone) */
    --navy-mid: #FAFAF7;    /* card surface */
    --navy-light: #F1EFE8;  /* card alt / hover */
    --navy-border: #E6E1D6; /* hairline */
    --brand: #1F3864;       /* navy accent */
    --brand-blue: #2B4A7A;
    --teal: #2E7D74;
    --teal-light: #70C49C;
    --teal-pale: #D6F0E8;
    --cream: #FAFAF7;
    --white: #20242B;       /* was heading text on dark; now dark ink on bone */
    --muted: #9A8F78;
    --text-light: #3A372F;  /* body text */
    --text-mid: #5F5A50;    /* secondary text */
    --green: #21823F;
    --red-subtle: #C0492F;
    --ink: #20242B;
    --navy-accent: #1F3864; /* real navy for accents/buttons on bone */
  }

  #pacerai-blog * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }

  #pacerai-blog {
    font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif;
    background: var(--navy);
    color: var(--text-light);
    overflow-x: hidden;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1.65;
  }

  /* ─── NAV ─── */
  #pacerai-blog nav {
    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    padding: 0 32px;
    height: 64px;
    background: rgba(245,244,239,.86);
    backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(10px);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
  }

  #pacerai-blog .nav-links {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px;
    list-style: none;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li { position: relative; }
  #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li > a {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px;
    padding: 8px 14px;
    font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    color: var(--text-mid);
    text-decoration: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    transition: color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li > a:hover { color: var(--white); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); }
  #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li > a .chevron {
    font-size: 10px; margin-top: 1px;
    transition: transform 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li:hover > a .chevron { transform: rotate(180deg); }

  /* Dropdown */
  #pacerai-blog .dropdown {
    display: none;
    position: absolute; top: 100%; left: 50%;
    transform: translateX(-50%);
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 20px;
    padding-top: 28px;
    min-width: 520px;
    box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  }
  #pacerai-blog .dropdown::before {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: -12px; left: 0; right: 0;
    height: 12px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li:hover .dropdown { display: block; }

  #pacerai-blog .dropdown-grid { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0 32px; }
  #pacerai-blog .dropdown-col-label {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal);
    padding-bottom: 10px; margin-bottom: 6px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
  }
  #pacerai-blog .dropdown a {
    display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px;
    padding: 10px 10px; border-radius: 8px;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background 0.15s;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .dropdown a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.04); }
  #pacerai-blog .dropdown .d-icon {
    width: 32px; height: 32px; flex-shrink: 0;
    background: var(--navy-light);
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    border-radius: 7px;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    font-size: 14px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .dropdown .d-text .d-title {
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--white);
    display: block; line-height: 1.3;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .dropdown .d-text .d-desc {
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.4;
    margin-top: 2px;
  }

  #pacerai-blog .single-dropdown { min-width: 220px; }
  #pacerai-blog .single-dropdown a {
    padding: 9px 12px; border-radius: 8px;
    text-decoration: none; display: block;
    font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-light);
    transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .single-dropdown a:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); color: var(--white); }

  /* Hamburger — hidden on desktop */
  #pacerai-blog .mobile-menu-btn {
    display: none;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 5px;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    cursor: pointer;
    padding: 8px;
    z-index: 101;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .mobile-menu-btn span {
    display: block;
    width: 22px; height: 2px;
    background: var(--text-light);
    border-radius: 2px;
    transition: all 0.3s;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .mobile-menu-btn.open span:nth-child(1) {
    transform: rotate(45deg) translate(5px, 5px);
  }
  #pacerai-blog .mobile-menu-btn.open span:nth-child(2) { opacity: 0; }
  #pacerai-blog .mobile-menu-btn.open span:nth-child(3) {
    transform: rotate(-45deg) translate(5px, -5px);
  }

  #pacerai-blog .nav-right {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .btn-ghost {
    padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--text-light); background: transparent;
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border); border-radius: 7px;
    cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .btn-ghost:hover { color: var(--white); border-color: rgba(39,137,154,0.45); }
  #pacerai-blog .btn-teal {
    padding: 9px 20px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600;
    color: #fff; background: var(--teal);
    border: none; border-radius: 7px;
    cursor: pointer; text-decoration: none;
    transition: all 0.2s; letter-spacing: 0.02em;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .btn-teal:hover { background: var(--teal-light); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(39,137,154,0.35); }

  /* ─── BLOG HERO ─── */
  #pacerai-blog .blog-hero {
    padding: 140px 48px 60px;
    text-align: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-hero .eyebrow {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 6px 16px 6px 8px;
    background: rgba(39,137,154,0.10);
    border: 1px solid rgba(39,137,154,0.22);
    border-radius: 100px;
    font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--teal);
    margin-bottom: 24px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-hero .dot {
    width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%;
    background: var(--teal);
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-hero h1 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(36px, 5vw, 56px);
    font-weight: 300; line-height: 1.1;
    color: var(--white);
    letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-hero h1 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-hero p {
    font-size: 17px; color: var(--text-mid);
    max-width: 560px; margin: 0 auto; line-height: 1.7;
  }

  /* ─── CATEGORY FILTER ─── */
  #pacerai-blog .category-bar {
    display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 8px;
    padding: 32px 48px;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .cat-pill {
    padding: 8px 18px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none;
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    border-radius: 100px; background: transparent;
    transition: all 0.2s; cursor: pointer;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .cat-pill:hover {
    color: var(--white); border-color: rgba(39,137,154,0.35);
    background: rgba(39,137,154,0.06);
  }
  #pacerai-blog .cat-pill.active {
    color: var(--teal); border-color: rgba(39,137,154,0.4);
    background: rgba(39,137,154,0.08); font-weight: 600;
  }

  /* ─── BLOG GRID ─── */
  #pacerai-blog .blog-grid {
    max-width: 1080px;
    margin: 0 auto;
    padding: 0 48px 100px;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
    gap: 24px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-grid .featured {
    grid-column: 1 / -1;
  }

  #pacerai-blog .blog-card {
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    border-radius: 16px;
    overflow: hidden;
    transition: all 0.25s;
    text-decoration: none;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-card:hover {
    background: var(--navy-light);
    border-color: rgba(39,137,154,0.3);
    transform: translateY(-2px);
    box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
  }

  #pacerai-blog .blog-card .card-body {
    padding: 32px;
    flex: 1;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-card.featured .card-body { padding: 40px; }

  #pacerai-blog .blog-card .card-meta {
    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-card .card-category {
    font-size: 10px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 4px;
    background: rgba(39,137,154,0.12); color: var(--teal);
    border: 1px solid rgba(39,137,154,0.22);
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-card .card-date {
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted);
  }

  #pacerai-blog .blog-card h2 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: 24px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--white);
    line-height: 1.2; margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-card.featured h2 {
    font-size: clamp(28px, 3vw, 36px);
  }

  #pacerai-blog .blog-card .card-excerpt {
    font-size: 14px; color: var(--text-mid); line-height: 1.7;
    flex: 1;
    display: -webkit-box;
    -webkit-line-clamp: 3;
    -webkit-box-orient: vertical;
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-card.featured .card-excerpt {
    -webkit-line-clamp: 4;
  }

  #pacerai-blog .blog-card .card-link {
    display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;
    margin-top: 20px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--teal); text-decoration: none;
    transition: gap 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .blog-card:hover .card-link { gap: 10px; }

  /* ─── NEWSLETTER CTA ─── */
  #pacerai-blog .wp-cta-card { max-width: 440px; margin: 24px auto 0; }
  #pacerai-blog .wp-cta-form { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  #pacerai-blog .wp-cta-form input[type="email"] {
    flex: 1 1 200px; min-width: 0; padding: 13px 15px; font-size: 15px;
    font-family: inherit; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    border-radius: 8px; color: #1A202C; outline: none;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .wp-cta-form input[type="email"]:focus { border-color: var(--teal); }
  #pacerai-blog .wp-cta-form button {
    flex: 0 0 auto; padding: 13px 22px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600;
    font-family: inherit; color: #fff; background: var(--teal);
    border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .wp-cta-form button:hover { filter: brightness(1.08); }
  #pacerai-blog .wp-cta-form button:disabled { opacity: .65; cursor: default; }
  #pacerai-blog .wp-cta-privacy { font-size: 12px; color: var(--text-muted, #94A3B8); margin-top: 10px; }
  #pacerai-blog .wp-cta-privacy a { color: var(--teal); text-decoration: underline; }

  #pacerai-blog .newsletter-section {
    padding: 80px 48px;
    background: var(--navy-mid);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    text-align: center;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .newsletter-section h2 {
    font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', serif;
    font-size: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 42px);
    font-weight: 300; color: var(--white);
    margin-bottom: 12px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .newsletter-section h2 em { font-style: italic; color: var(--teal); }
  #pacerai-blog .newsletter-section p {
    font-size: 15px; color: var(--text-mid);
    max-width: 480px; margin: 0 auto 28px; line-height: 1.7;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .newsletter-section .btn-teal {
    padding: 14px 30px; font-size: 15px;
  }

  /* ─── FOOTER ─── */
  #pacerai-blog footer {
    background: var(--navy);
    border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    padding: 80px 48px 40px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-top {
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: 240px 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
    gap: 48px;
    padding-bottom: 64px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
    margin-bottom: 40px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-brand p {
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.7; margin-top: 16px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-col-head {
    font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em;
    text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--text-light);
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-col ul { list-style: none; }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-col ul li { margin-bottom: 10px; }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-col ul li a {
    font-size: 13px; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-col ul li a:hover { color: var(--teal); }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-bottom {
    display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;
    flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-bottom .copy {
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0.03em;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-bottom .legal { display: flex; gap: 24px; }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-bottom .legal a {
    font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }
  #pacerai-blog .footer-bottom .legal a:hover { color: var(--text-mid); }

  /* ─── MOBILE ─── */
  @media (max-width: 768px) {
    #pacerai-blog nav {
      padding: 0 16px;
      height: 56px;
      backdrop-filter: none;
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
      background: #F5F4EF;
      overflow: visible;
    }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links {
      display: none !important;
      position: fixed;
      top: 56px; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      background: #F5F4EF;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: stretch;
      padding: 16px 20px;
      overflow-y: auto;
      z-index: 200;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--navy-border);
      list-style: none;
    }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links.mobile-open { display: flex !important; }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li { border-bottom: 1px solid var(--navy-border); }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li > a {
      padding: 16px 0; font-size: 16px; border-bottom: none;
      display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #CDD5E0;
    }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li > a:hover { background: none; }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links .dropdown {
      position: static !important; transform: none !important;
      min-width: 0 !important; background: transparent !important;
      border: none !important; box-shadow: none !important;
      padding: 0 0 12px 16px !important; border-radius: 0 !important;
      padding-top: 0 !important;
    }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links .dropdown::before { display: none; }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li:hover .dropdown { display: none !important; }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li.mobile-expanded .dropdown { display: block !important; }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links .dropdown a { padding: 10px 0; font-size: 14px; color: #94A3B8; }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links .dropdown-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-right .btn-ghost { display: none; }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-right .btn-teal { padding: 7px 14px; font-size: 12px; }
    #pacerai-blog .mobile-menu-btn { display: flex !important; }

    #pacerai-blog .blog-hero { padding: 90px 20px 40px; }
    #pacerai-blog .blog-hero h1 { font-size: 32px; }
    #pacerai-blog .category-bar { padding: 24px 20px; }
    #pacerai-blog .blog-grid {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      padding: 0 20px 60px;
    }
    #pacerai-blog .blog-card.featured { grid-column: 1; }
    #pacerai-blog .blog-card .card-body { padding: 24px; }
    #pacerai-blog .newsletter-section { padding: 60px 20px; }
    #pacerai-blog footer { padding: 48px 20px 32px; }
    #pacerai-blog .footer-top {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
      gap: 32px 24px;
    }
    #pacerai-blog .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
    #pacerai-blog .footer-bottom {
      flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 12px;
    }
    #pacerai-blog .footer-bottom .legal { flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; }
  }

  @media (max-width: 1024px) and (min-width: 769px) {
    #pacerai-blog nav { padding: 0 24px; }
    #pacerai-blog .nav-links > li > a { padding: 8px 8px; font-size: 12px; }
    #pacerai-blog .blog-hero { padding: 120px 24px 48px; }
    #pacerai-blog .blog-grid { padding: 0 24px 80px; }
    #pacerai-blog .footer-top {
      grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px;
    }
    #pacerai-blog .footer-brand { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
    #pacerai-blog footer { padding: 60px 24px 32px; }
  }

@media(max-width:768px){.footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;gap:24px !important;padding:40px 24px 24px !important}.footer-brand{text-align:center}}
.footer-top{display:grid;grid-template-columns:260px repeat(4,1fr);gap:32px;max-width:1200px;margin:0 auto;padding:64px 48px 40px}.footer-tagline{font-size:13px;color:var(--text-mid);line-height:1.6;margin-top:12px}@media(max-width:768px){.footer-top{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;gap:24px !important;padding:40px 24px 24px !important}.footer-brand{text-align:center}}#pacerai-blog h1,#pacerai-blog h2,#pacerai-blog h3,#pacerai-blog h4,#pacerai-blog h5,#pacerai-blog .nav-logo{font-family:'DM Sans',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif !important}
